reason: Independent design review identified original center tanh versus normalized G as a combined parameterization change. Add a normalized physical-reference-center arm to separate this factor.
physical_reference_center: Cfree=5*q; chord ell=.35*tanh(chord_raw) exactly as both other arms. Same original domain, same feasibility backtracking.
historical_bridge: original_raw versus original formal v2; original_raw versus greville combines center tanh removal with coordinate map.
identical_budget: All three arms run 100 image steps and 100 prior-only steps; 600 training image objective backward calls per image fit, excluding declared preflight/final reporting. Equal objective budget, not identical wall time or FLOPs.
fail_rule: Any infeasible step after 30 halvings aborts whole experiment; no scores until all arms completed.
numerical_tests: actual initial image objective abs <1e-6; vertex max <2e-6m; chain gradient relative L2 <2e-4; these are float32 implementation checks, not physical tolerance.
